key_people.name: Judy Rogers (朱迪·罗杰斯)
key_people.title: Chancellor
key_people.title_description: Ceremonial head of the university, presiding over convocation and representing the university at official events
key_people.description: 20th Chancellor of UBC, appointed July 2024. Former City Manager of Vancouver (1999-2008), first female to hold that position. UBC alumna with extensive career in public administration and governance.

key_people.name: Benoit-Antoine Bacon (贝努瓦-安托万·巴孔)
key_people.title: President and Vice-Chancellor
key_people.title_description: Chief executive officer leading the academic mission and operations of UBC
key_people.description: 17th President of UBC, assumed office November 1, 2023 for a five-year term. Canadian neuropsychologist, previously served as 15th President of Carleton University (2018-2023). Also serves on the Board of Directors of Universities Canada since 2020.

key_people.name: Gage Averill (盖奇·阿弗里尔)
key_people.title: Provost and Vice-President Academic, UBC Vancouver
key_people.title_description: Chief academic officer for the Vancouver campus overseeing all academic programs and faculty
key_people.description: Serves as Provost for UBC's Vancouver campus, responsible for academic leadership across all Vancouver faculties and schools.

key_people.name: Rehan Sadiq (雷汉·萨迪克)
key_people.title: Provost and Vice-President Academic, UBC Okanagan
key_people.title_description: Chief academic officer for the Okanagan campus in Kelowna
key_people.description: Serves as Provost for UBC's Okanagan campus, overseeing academic programs and operations at the Kelowna location.

departments.name: 文学院 (Faculty of Arts)
departments.description: Largest faculty at UBC Vancouver with twenty departments and schools, dating back to the 1915 Fairview Campus. Covers humanities, social sciences, and creative arts.

departments.name: 理学院 (Faculty of Science)
departments.description: Second largest faculty at UBC with nine departments, established when the Faculty of Arts and Science split in 1964. Covers biological, physical, and mathematical sciences.

departments.name: 尚德商学院 (Sauder School of Business)
departments.description: UBC's Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration, one of Canada's leading business schools with strong Asia-Pacific connections.

departments.name: 应用科学学院 (Faculty of Applied Science)
departments.description: Houses UBC Engineering and School of Architecture, offering accredited programs in engineering and architectural disciplines.

departments.name: 医学院 (Faculty of Medicine)
departments.description: One of Canada's largest medical faculties, delivering medical doctor training across BC including the Southern Medical Program at UBC Okanagan and clinical campuses at Vancouver General Hospital.

departments.name: 教育学院 (Faculty of Education)
departments.description: One of Canada's leading faculties of education, preparing teachers and educational researchers.

departments.name: 法学院 (Peter A. Allard School of Law)
departments.description: One of Canada's premier law schools, producing numerous Supreme Court justices and legal scholars.

departments.name: 林学院 (Faculty of Forestry)
departments.description: Recognized globally for forestry research and education, reflecting BC's significant forest industry.

departments.name: 土地与食品系统学院 (Faculty of Land and Food Systems)
departments.description: Focused on sustainable food systems, agriculture, and nutritional sciences, one of UBC's original faculties.

departments.name: 公共政策与全球事务学院 (School of Public Policy and Global Affairs)
departments.description: Houses the Institute of Asian Research (IAR), founded in 1978 as the focal point for Asia-related policy and interdisciplinary scholarship. Home to the Centre for the Study of Democratic Institutions.

departments.name: 牙科学院 (Faculty of Dentistry)
departments.description: Offers Canada's second-largest dental education program, located at the Vancouver campus.

departments.name: 温哥华经济学院 (Vancouver School of Economics)
departments.description: Established in 2012 in conjunction with Sauder School of Business, one of Canada's top economics departments. Nobel laureate Robert Mundell was an alumnus.

recent_events.title: UBC launches Strategic Directions 2025-2030
recent_events.description: UBC formally launched its refreshed strategic plan following endorsement by the Board of Governors and both Senates. The plan establishes seven priority areas to position the university amid significant global challenges, building on existing strengths in research, sustainability, and global engagement.
recent_events.impact: Sets UBC's institutional direction for the next five years, reinforcing its commitment to being a globally influential research university

recent_events.title: UBC celebrates enduring ties with Guangdong and Guangzhou
recent_events.description: UBC marked the 40th anniversary of the Vancouver-Guangzhou sister-city relationship and the 30th anniversary of the BC-Guangdong sister-province partnership by hosting a reception in Guangzhou for partners, alumni, and friends. President Bacon led a delegation visiting South China University of Technology and South China Normal University.
recent_events.impact: Strengthens UBC's deep-rooted connections with China and the Asia-Pacific region, advancing collaborative research and student exchange

recent_events.title: UBC announces 2026 spring honorary degree recipients
recent_events.description: UBC announced it will confer nine honorary degrees in spring 2026, recognizing ten remarkable individuals including Nobel Prize-winning chemist Sir David W.C. MacMillan, business leader Ryan Beedie, and physician Dr. Alika Lafontaine.
recent_events.impact: Highlights UBC's ongoing commitment to recognizing excellence across sciences, business, and public service

recent_events.title: UBC Board of Governors approves balanced operating budget for 2025/26
recent_events.description: UBC projected a balanced financial position as part of its 2025/26 budget of CA$3.8 billion, approved by the Board of Governors. Government grants account for approximately 40% of total revenues, and student tuition approximately 41%.
recent_events.impact: Demonstrates UBC's financial resilience and capacity to sustain its research and academic mission

recent_events.title: UBC President Bacon visits China to strengthen academic partnerships
recent_events.description: President Benoit-Antoine Bacon visited South China Normal University and South China University of Technology in Guangzhou, meeting with university leaders and discussing expanded collaboration in research and education. The visit marked the 55th anniversary of China-Canada diplomatic relations.
recent_events.impact: Advances UBC's strategic priority of deepening engagement with Asia-Pacific academic institutions

core_business: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学（UBC）是加拿大顶尖公立研究型大学，成立于1908年，拥有温哥华和基洛纳两个校区。作为加拿大U15研究型大学联盟成员和环太平洋大学联盟（APRU）唯一的加拿大成员，UBC在亚太地区学术合作中扮演独特角色。学校年度研究预算达8.93亿加元，每年资助9992个研究项目，涵盖量子物理、生物医学、人工智能、可持续发展等前沿领域。UBC拥有12个学院（温哥华校区）和7个学院（基洛纳校区），在校学生总数超过53000人，其中国际学生约占28%。学校拥有TRIUMF国家粒子物理实验室、斯图尔特·布鲁森量子物质研究所等世界级研究设施，并与马克斯·普朗克学会合作建立了北美首个马克斯·普朗克研究所。UBC培养出8位诺贝尔奖得主、75位罗德学者和231位奥运选手，四位加拿大总理曾在UBC学习。
apec_stance: UBC作为环太平洋大学联盟（APRU）唯一的加拿大成员机构，在亚太经合组织（APEC）区域的知识创新与学术合作中发挥着桥梁作用。UBC的亚洲研究所（Institute of Asian Research）成立于1978年，是加拿大研究亚太地区政策与事务的核心学术机构。学校积极参与加拿大印太战略框架下的学术合作，与亚太地区200多所伙伴大学建立了交流项目。2025年12月，UBC校长率团访问中国广州，纪念温哥华-广州缔结友好城市40周年和BC省-广东省结好30周年，彰显了学校对亚太地区长期合作的战略承诺。UBC通过Sauder商学院的亚太商业教育项目、公共政策学院的亚太治理研究以及与华南理工大学、中山大学等机构的联合研究，持续为APEC经济体间的人才流动和知识共享做出贡献。学校在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第40名，是加拿大排名前三的研究型大学之一。
